entries.note: Input estimate is bounded-diff characters / 4 plus prompt overhead; output estimate is measured characters / 4. Published-price estimate rounds upward to the next cent.

entries.description: Offline measurement plus emit_pr_receipt.py and aragora-verify replay from committed CollectOutcome fixtures.
entries.note: No model calls and no network required; this is the zero-spend validator path.

rounding_policy: Each non-negligible review batch is conservatively rounded upward to the next USD cent after a characters/4 token proxy is priced; cumulative fields are the exact arithmetic sum of the stored per-entry estimated_cost_usd values. M8=0.2301; M9=0.0001+0.13+0.0+0.2+0.0=0.3301; total=0.5602.
note: Costs are estimates based on published per-token pricing (xai grok-4 ~$5/$15 per 1M in/out; mistral-large ~$2/$6 per 1M in/out). Actual provider invoices were not available in-session. Stored estimates are conservative upper bounds. Cumulative is the exact sum of entries and remains well under the $100 cap.
